people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Sennacherib king of Assyria says, “In whom do you trust, that you remain under siege in Jerusalem?
translations.bsb: “This is what Sennacherib king of Assyria says: What is the basis of your confidence, that you remain in Jerusalem under siege?
translations.kjv: Thus saith Sennacherib king of Assyria, Whereon do ye trust, that ye abide in the siege in Jerusalem?
translations.asv: Thus saith Sennacherib king of Assyria, Whereon do ye trust, that ye abide the siege in Jerusalem?
